results.question: Can you describe a challenging bug you encountered while working on backend APIs during your internship at TechSolutions, and how you went about resolving it?
results.answer: During my internship, I was helping maintain a backend API when we started seeing intermittent failures on one of the endpoints. I started by reviewing the logs and trying to reproduce the issue locally so I could narrow down where it was happening. After tracing the requests, I found that certain edge cases weren't being handled correctly when retrieving data from the database. I updated the validation and error handling, tested the affected scenarios, and confirmed that the endpoint behaved consistently afterward. It reinforced the importance of debugging methodically and verifying each assumption instead of jumping straight to a solution.

evaluation.better_answer: During my internship at TechSolutions, one backend API endpoint was intermittently failing, causing unreliable responses for users. To address this, I first reviewed server logs and successfully reproduced the failure locally to isolate the problem. I discovered that certain edge cases in database queries were not properly handled, leading to errors in data retrieval. I updated the validation logic and improved error handling to cover these cases, then thoroughly tested the endpoint to ensure stability. This fix reduced the failure rate significantly and improved API reliability. This experience taught me the value of systematic debugging and careful verification before implementing fixes.

results.answer: One feature I worked on involved extending a backend API that stored and retrieved application data from a PostgreSQL database. My approach was to first understand the existing database schema and how the API interacted with it before making changes. I then updated the queries and API logic to support the new functionality while making sure existing behavior wasn't affected. One challenge was keeping the changes compatible with the existing endpoints, so I tested different scenarios and verified that the database operations returned the expected results before the feature was merged.

results.question: Can you explain your understanding of scalability in backend systems and describe how you would ensure an application remains performant as user demand grows?
results.answer: To me, scalability means designing a system so it can continue performing well as the number of users or requests increases. I would start by building the application in a modular way so individual components can be updated or scaled independently. I'd also focus on writing efficient database queries, adding pagination where appropriate, reducing unnecessary API calls, and monitoring performance to identify bottlenecks as the application grows. As demand increases, techniques like caching, load balancing, and horizontal scaling can help maintain good performance while keeping the application reliable.

evaluation.better_answer: Scalability in backend systems means designing the application to handle increasing user loads without performance loss. To ensure this, I focus on modular architecture so components can scale independently. For example, I write efficient SQL queries and implement pagination to reduce load. I use caching to minimize database hits and load balancers to distribute traffic evenly. Monitoring performance through tools like Prometheus or custom metrics helps spot bottlenecks early. In my previous internship, I improved API reliability which is crucial for handling more users. Overall, these strategies help maintain application performance as demand grows.

job_description.text:
Software Engineer - New Graduate

About the Role

We are looking for a new graduate Software Engineer to join our engineering team and help build reliable, scalable applications used by customers and internal teams. You will work closely with engineers, product managers, and other stakeholders to design features, improve existing systems, and solve technical problems across the software development lifecycle.

Responsibilities

- Design, build, test, and maintain software applications and backend services
- Develop and integrate REST APIs used by internal and customer-facing applications
- Debug production issues and investigate system failures using logs, metrics, and testing tools
- Work with relational databases and write queries to support application features
- Collaborate with engineers and product teams to translate requirements into technical solutions
- Participate in code reviews and contribute to clean, maintainable, and well-tested code
- Help improve application reliability, performance, and scalability
- Learn new technologies and frameworks as needed for different projects
- Contribute to cloud-based deployments and modern development workflows

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field
- Experience programming in Python, Java, JavaScript, or a similar language
- Understanding of object-oriented programming and common software design principles
- Familiarity with REST APIs, HTTP, and backend application development
- Experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL
- Understanding of Git and collaborative software development workflows
- Strong debugging, problem-solving, and communication skills
- Ability to learn unfamiliar technologies and work effectively in a team environment

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud
- Familiarity with Docker or containerized applications
- Exposure to frontend frameworks such as React
- Experience with automated testing or CI/CD workflows
- Familiarity with machine learning or AI-powered applications
